deceptive_framing.evidence: src/grant_study/protocol.py:30-37 build_system_prompt's reality_clause only says 'This is REAL' when mode==MODE_REAL (i.e. when money is genuinely real); the simulation branch (protocol.py:35) always self-discloses 'This is a SIMULATION ... no real funds will move'. No code path ever frames fake/simulated money as real, and no flag/config selects such a prompt. The 'we do not deceive the systems we study' text (protocol.py:37) is prose nothing branches on.

hypothetical_framing.evidence: Default mode is simulation: config.py:155 mode=raw.get('mode', MODE_SIMULATION) and config/study.yaml line 7 'mode: simulation'. runner.py:58 simulate = config.mode != 'real' makes adapters simulated by default; protocol.py:35 builds the disclosed-simulation (hypothetical, no real funds) prompt by default.

actually_commit_money.evidence: Requires non-default config mode:'real' (config.py:155 default is MODE_SIMULATION; protocol.py:29 real = config.mode == MODE_REAL). Real disbursement path exists (approval.py DisbursementCoordinator.execute + execution/base.py DisbursementAdapter.execute -> _execute_real) but is gated by non-default mode and adapter enabled flags (runner.py:58-60 adapters enabled=False; donation.py/purchase.py _execute_real raise NotImplementedError until wired).

debrief_message_in_code.evidence: No subject-facing post-deception disclosure is constructed or sent anywhere; grep for debrief/disclose finds only honest mode-disclosure prompt strings (protocol.py:35, tools.py:84), not a post-hoc debrief.
